name: Natsuki Rino
source:
A cheeky gyaru who suddenly appeared at the start of the new school term, who recklessly lashes out at people indiscriminately. 

An egotistic, arrogant, sharp-tongued girl who judges men by their wealth and looks. Is ill-natured, but is actually lonely and wants to be spoiled. 

Has few friends due to her putting on a facade of strength, which makes her unapproachable. She tends to be dependent on someone she comes to trust. 

Dumb, but has an appearance akin to a model. Contrary to her flashy looks, she actually lacks sexual knowledge, and is a virgin.

[Translated from [url=http://pachi2.com/oshioki/chara.html]Official Site[/url]]
